# Kenney Blaster Kit (third-party weapon placeholder)

Source: **Kenney — Blaster Kit 2.1** — https://kenney.nl/assets/blaster-kit
Author: Kenney (https://kenney.nl)
License: **Creative Commons Zero (CC0 1.0)** — https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

CC0 places the work in the public domain, so the models and texture may be stored in this public
repository, modified, and redistributed without restriction. Attribution is not required (credit
to Kenney is appreciated).

Files included here are a small subset of the kit, used as the current production-quality
placeholder weapon (see `Assets/Scripts/M7/Prefabs/...` integration and `M7PlayerBodyBuilder`):

- `blaster-a.fbx`, `blaster-b.fbx`, `blaster-c.fbx` — candidate stylised sci-fi blasters
- `Textures/colormap.png` — the kit's shared palette texture
- `License-Kenney.txt` — the license file shipped with the download

Downloaded from:
`https://kenney.nl/media/pages/assets/blaster-kit/261d80a716-1753959510/kenney_blaster-kit_2.1.zip`
